description: Source file for ANGLE project that handles querying and translating OpenGL image formats to Direct3D 9 formats, including format info, format mapping, and vertex attribute conversions.

classes.name: D3DFormat
classes.description: Represents a Direct3D 9 format with pixel size, block size, bits, and format ID.

classes.name: TextureFormat
classes.description: Holds information about a texture format, including D3D format identifiers and data initialization functions.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Describes vertex attribute format, including conversion type, size, and native D3D format.

methods.name: GetD3DFormatInfo
methods.description: Returns format info for a given D3DFORMAT.

methods.name: BuildInternalFormatInitialzerMap
methods.description: Builds a map of internal formats to their data initialization functions.

methods.name: BuildD3D9FormatMap
methods.description: Constructs a map from OpenGL internal formats to D3D formats and load functions.

methods.name: GetTextureFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves texture format info for a given OpenGL internal format.

methods.name: GetDeclTypeComponentType
methods.description: Returns the GL component type for a given D3DDECLTYPE.

methods.name: CreateVertexFormatInfo
methods.description: Initializes a VertexFormat with conversion info.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatInfo
methods.description: Returns vertex format info based on supported decl types and vertex format ID.
